gameOver.message: Player Gem25P Tinker is the winner

annotations.description: Gem25P Tinker missed their Turn 1 land drop entirely despite having 4 lands in hand (Command Tower, Dragonskull Summit, Swamp, Temple of Malice). This resulted in being forced to discard during cleanup and falling a full turn behind on mana development in a format where early ramp is critical.
annotations.actionTaken: Failed to play a land on Turn 1, resulting in having to discard to hand size during cleanup step.
annotations.betterLine: Should have played Command Tower (or Temple of Malice for the scry) on Turn 1 to develop mana on schedule. Command Tower untapped would allow Turn 2 Fellwar Stone or Sword of the Chosen.

annotations.description: Fetched Forest when they already have abundant green sources (Forest on battlefield, Forest in hand, Necroblossom Snarl). Blue is their scarcest color with only Command Tower producing it, and their commander Galea requires U. An Island would provide redundancy for their most critical missing color.
annotations.actionTaken: Fetched Forest with Ash Barrens basic landcycling
annotations.betterLine: Fetch Island to have a second blue source for casting Galea and reduce vulnerability to losing Command Tower as the only blue source

annotations.description: Playing Flood Plain (enters tapped) instead of Exotic Orchard (enters untapped) wastes the entire turn 4 with no spells cast. Exotic Orchard would provide a third mana, enabling Swiftfoot Boots (2 mana) to be cast this turn with 1 mana left over for Brainstorm.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Flood Plain, which enters tapped, leaving only 2 mana available and no spells cast on turn 4.
annotations.betterLine: Play Exotic Orchard (untapped), then cast Swiftfoot Boots for 2, with 1 mana held up for Brainstorm. Save Flood Plain for a later turn when the tempo loss matters less.

annotations.description: Cast Swiftfoot Boots with no creatures on the battlefield. The reasoning incorrectly claims there's a 3/3 Elemental to protect, but no creatures exist on MiniMx's board. While Boots can prepare for a future Galea cast, activating Flood Plain to fetch a basic land could accelerate reaching 5 mana for Galea (which costs {1}{G}{W}{U}) sooner.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Swiftfoot Boots with no creatures on the battlefield
annotations.betterLine: Activate Flood Plain to fetch a basic land (likely Island or Plains), accelerating toward casting Galea next turn. Boots could be cast later when closer to deploying a creature.

annotations.description: Spending 3 mana (2R) and tapping Shivan Gorge to deal 1 damage to each opponent is extremely inefficient at this stage of the game. With 40 life opponents, dealing 1 damage is negligible. Meanwhile, Gem25P Tinker has Oketra's Monument and Kari Zev in hand that could be cast to develop the board. The 3 mana spent on Shivan Gorge's ability plus the mana from other lands could have been used to cast Oketra's Monument (3 mana) to set up future cost reduction and token generation, which would have been far more impactful. Additionally, tapping Shivan Gorge means it can't produce colorless mana for other uses this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Shivan Gorge's damage ability for 2R+T to deal 1 damage to each opponent.
annotations.betterLine: Tap Shivan Gorge for colorless mana instead, and use the mana to cast Oketra's Monument (3 mana) to set up future value with creature spell cost reduction and token generation, especially since Kari Zev is in hand.

annotations.description: Fetched Island when Plains would better support the hand's mana requirements. The player already has Prairie Stream for Blue and has Halimar Depths and Lumbering Falls in hand for additional Blue. Meanwhile, Valiant Endeavor requires {W}{W} and the player only has Canopy Vista and Prairie Stream for White. A Plains would also help ensure future dual lands with basic land requirements enter untapped.
annotations.actionTaken: Fetched Island with Flood Plain
annotations.betterLine: Fetch Plains to better support Valiant Endeavor's {W}{W} cost and provide a basic land for threshold requirements, given Blue is already well-covered by Prairie Stream and hand contains Halimar Depths and Lumbering Falls

annotations.description: With Galea as commander (who casts Aura/Equipment from top of library), Halimar Depths' ability to arrange the top 3 cards is extremely synergistic and valuable. Since MiniMx Memoir appears to have no meaningful plays with remaining mana this turn, the tempo cost of a tapped land is negligible. Grasslands is also arguably better as it provides future ramp when cracked.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Exotic Orchard, which enters untapped but provides no special advantage this turn.
annotations.betterLine: Play Halimar Depths to arrange top 3 cards of library for Galea synergy (or Grasslands for future ramp), since entering tapped has minimal cost when there are no remaining plays this turn.

annotations.description: Gem25P Tinker passed on activating Shivan Gorge ({2}{R}, {T}: deal 1 damage to each opponent) during combat when they had the mana available (Command Tower, Dragonskull Summit, Temple of Malice, Fellwar Stone, Shivan Gorge itself for colorless, plus Mobilized District). This is a free damage ability with no downside - 1 damage to all three opponents for 3 mana at instant speed. Additionally, they then had to discard Oketra's Monument and Ambition's Cost to hand size, losing significant card advantage. The discard of Ambition's Cost (draw 3 cards) and Oketra's Monument (cost reduction + token generation) represents substantial lost value. While discarding was forced by the hand size limit, they could have at minimum used Shivan Gorge to spend mana productively, and the choice to discard Ambition's Cost over other cards like Geier Reach Sanitarium is questionable since Ambition's Cost provides much more card advantage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without activating any abilities, then discarded Oketra's Monument and Ambition's Cost to hand size.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Shivan Gorge to deal 1 damage to each opponent (free incremental damage with no downside). For the discard, keeping Ambition's Cost over Geier Reach Sanitarium would have been better since drawing 3 cards is more impactful than the Sanitarium's symmetrical draw/discard effect.

annotations.description: Psychic Impetus was cast targeting a 1/1 Human Soldier Token controlled by MiMo Gramps. This makes the token a 3/3 goaded creature that must attack someone other than MiniMx Memoir. However, MiMo Gramps has Omen of the Sun and could sacrifice it or the token could easily be blocked and killed. More importantly, putting an Aura on a 1/1 token is extremely risky - tokens are fragile and if the token dies, the Aura is lost for no value. Psychic Impetus is much better on a larger, harder-to-remove creature like The Peregrine Dynamo (1/5 body, harder to kill in combat) which would force Gem25P Tinker to attack others while giving MiniMx Memoir scry 2 triggers. The reasoning stated in the decision ('gives card draw when enchanted creature dies') is factually wrong about what the card does - it gives +2/+2, goads, and scries on attack. The player misread their own card.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Psychic Impetus on MiMo Gramps' 1/1 Human Soldier Token
annotations.betterLine: Cast Psychic Impetus on a more durable creature like The Peregrine Dynamo (1/5 with haste) to get reliable scry 2 triggers and force a relevant threat to attack other players, or hold the Impetus for a better target. Alternatively, could have played Halimar Depths or another land and used Vitu-Ghazi to make a token.

annotations.description: MiniMx Memoir cast Verdant Embrace targeting an opponent's Human Soldier Token (MiMo Gramps' creature), not their own creature. MiniMx Memoir has no creatures on the battlefield - only lands, Swiftfoot Boots, and Arcane Signet. Verdant Embrace is an Aura that enchants a creature, giving it +3/+3 and creating 1/1 Saproling tokens at each upkeep. By enchanting an opponent's creature, MiniMx Memoir is giving MiMo Gramps a 4/4 soldier and the Saproling token generation. The reasoning also confuses Verdant Embrace with a completely different card (it doesn't create 2/2 flying Spirit tokens). Since MiniMx Memoir has no creatures of their own, they should have held the Verdant Embrace until they could put it on their own creature, or played a land drop first (they have several lands in hand including Halimar Depths, Lumbering Falls, etc.) and used Vitu-Ghazi to make a Saproling token to enchant on a future turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Verdant Embrace targeting MiMo Gramps' Human Soldier Token, buffing an opponent's creature and giving them the Saproling generation.
annotations.betterLine: Play a land (Halimar Depths for scrying, or Lumbering Falls), save Verdant Embrace for when you have your own creature to enchant. Could activate Vitu-Ghazi to create a Saproling token on a future turn to enchant with Verdant Embrace.

annotations.description: With a hand of all lands and no spells, playing Forest provides no meaningful advantage over Halimar Depths, which would let them arrange the top 3 cards of their library to find action. The enters-tapped drawback of Halimar Depths is negligible when there are no spells in hand to cast this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Forest as their land for turn

annotations.description: MiMo Gramps is scrying 2 (from sacrificing Omen of the Sun) and choosing which card to put on the bottom. They have Sigil of the Empty Throne and Dreadhorde Invasion as the two cards. With 8 lands on board (including Necroblossom Snarl and Command Tower for black), they could cast either card next turn. However, Sigil of the Empty Throne at 5 mana (3WW) is a powerful enchantment payoff that creates 4/4 flying Angels whenever they cast enchantment spells. They already have Arasta of the Endless Web and Spirited Companion in hand (both enchantments), plus Verdant Embrace is an enchantment in their deck. Sigil would generate significant value from their enchantment-heavy strategy. Dreadhorde Invasion is a 2-mana enchantment that slowly creates a growing Zombie Army token but costs 1 life per turn (they're already at 27 life). Keeping Sigil on top would be significantly better as it provides immediate synergy with their hand full of enchantments and generates much more impactful tokens (4/4 flyers vs slowly growing a single token). Bottoming Sigil in favor of Dreadhorde Invasion loses meaningful value.

annotations.betterLine: Put Dreadhorde Invasion on the bottom, keeping Sigil of the Empty Throne on top to cast it and then trigger it with Spirited Companion and Arasta of the Endless Web for 4/4 Angel tokens

annotations.description: Playing Bant Panorama over Halimar Depths is debatable. With a hand full of lands and only Eel Umbra as a spell, Halimar Depths would let MiniMx Memoir look at the top 3 cards and reorder them, potentially finding action cards instead of more land drops. Bant Panorama enters untapped and can be sacrificed later to fetch a basic, but they already have 8 lands on the battlefield and are flooding out. Halimar Depths' scry-like effect would help find spells to actually impact the board. However, Bant Panorama does provide immediate untapped colorless mana and a future land-thinning effect, so the choice isn't terrible.
annotations.actionTaken: Played Bant Panorama as their land for the turn
annotations.betterLine: Play Halimar Depths to look at the top 3 cards and reorder them to find action, since the hand is all lands plus one Eel Umbra and the player needs spells. Bant Panorama could be played on a future turn.

annotations.description: Eel Umbra was cast targeting Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree, which is a land — not a creature. Vitu-Ghazi only becomes a creature when its activated ability resolves ({2}{G}{W}, {T}: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token — wait, actually Vitu-Ghazi creates tokens, it doesn't become a creature). Looking more carefully, Vitu-Ghazi is just a land that makes Saproling tokens. It is never a creature. Eel Umbra requires 'Enchant creature' so it cannot legally enchant Vitu-Ghazi. Even if the game engine allowed this, it's wasting a card on a non-creature permanent. The player should have held Eel Umbra as a combat trick with flash for a future creature, or passed the turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Eel Umbra targeting Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree (a land, not a creature)
annotations.betterLine: Pass the turn and hold Eel Umbra for later use as a flash combat trick on an actual creature, or play Halimar Depths/Lumbering Falls/Grasslands instead to develop the board

annotations.description: Eel Umbra gives +1/+1 and umbra armor (destruction protection) to the enchanted creature. Putting it on a 1/1 Saproling token that MiniMx Memoir controls is a waste of a card with flash that could protect a much more valuable creature. The player has Setessan Champion (which draws cards from enchantments entering and grows with +1/+1 counters) and Kari Zev on the battlefield. Enchanting Setessan Champion would trigger Constellation (drawing a card and adding a +1/+1 counter), making it a 3/5, AND giving it destruction protection via umbra armor. Enchanting a Saproling token wastes the umbra armor protection on a disposable token and misses the Constellation trigger entirely.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted a Saproling Token with Eel Umbra, making it a 2/2 with umbra armor.
annotations.betterLine: Target Setessan Champion with Eel Umbra to trigger Constellation (draw a card, +1/+1 counter), making it a 3/5 with umbra armor destruction protection.
